title: Once another term is saved, the inactive term is no longer offered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 60, which is deactivated.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
  2. Choose "Net 30" in Credit Terms.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open Edit Customer again.
  5. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Net 60 (Inactive)" is selected.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown shows Net 30.

Step 3:

  • The customer saves on Net 30.

Step 4:

  • Credit Terms reads Net 30.

Step 5:

  • "Net 60" and "Net 60 (Inactive)" are not offered any more.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R13: “Once another term is picked and saved, the inactive term is no longer offered to that customer.”
  • S5-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a customer not already on them.”
  • S5-R12: “The inactive term stays selected until the user picks another term.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
